q: Which of the following statements is not true in respect of SEZs?
options: SEZs are duty free enclaves of developments and to promote FDI
A SEZ can be setup in the public sector, private sector or joint sector or even by the state governments in collaboration with any corporate body
A SEZ may be setup to manufacture goods or render services
A SEZ is setup primarily with the objective of generating employment opportunities
key_text: A SEZ is setup primarily with the objective of generating employment opportunities
explanation: SEZs are export-oriented duty-free enclaves, so 'set up primarily to generate employment' is not true; the other statements match the Act.

notes.text: - **Not true:** "SEZ is set up **primarily** to generate employment" – SEZs are **export-oriented** (APPSC G2 2017).

q: 100% Foreign Direct Investment is permitted in
explanation: 100% FDI under the automatic route is allowed for most manufacturing in Special Economic Zones (the EPZs were converted into SEZs from 2000); industrial areas and estates are not such a regime (printed key: Industrial Areas).

notes.text: - **100% FDI** under the automatic route for most manufacturing in SEZs.

q: Total investment in Special Economic Zones by 31 Dec. 2011
explanation: Per the Economic Survey 2011-12, total investment in SEZs as on 31 December 2011 was ₹2,49,630.80 crore.

notes.text: - Total investment in SEZs by **31 Dec 2011**: **₹2,49,630 crore** (Economic Survey 2011-12).

exam: APPSC Civil Assistant Surgeon (Specialist) in AP Vaidya Vidh
q: Out of the SEZs in India, the maximum number are in the following sector?
explanation: IT/ITES SEZs are the largest group among India's notified SEZs, far ahead of textiles, engineering and pharma.
